items.q: Do most Buddhists worship the Buddha as a god?
items.correct: No — most regard the Buddha as a teacher who showed the path.
items.misconception: Yes, the Buddha is worshipped as a creator god.
items.why: Buddhism generally does not centre on a creator God.

items.correct: No — it also involves ethics (e.g. the Eightfold Path) and community.
items.why: The path includes wisdom, ethical conduct and mental discipline.
